title: Page 8
content_zh:
「我、我要辞职，我不要再看到你了！」
昨天晚上她想了一晚，辞职的念头已经在脑海里存在很久，只是一直下不了决心，但是最近他对她越来越好……
没错，她知道自己很矛盾，可是他对她越好，她就越害怕、越不安。
她怕自己再有期待，也受不了再次的失望。
现在她的情况已经跟以前不同，她有小佟，她不能够垮掉。她很清楚，如果自己再次迷恋上他，然后又被无情的甩掉，她将再也爬不起来。
所以她好害怕……
「辞职？不行！我不准！」跟预期差距太大的反应让苏劲沧根本无法接受。
他不是个可以接受拒绝的人。他第一次想要追求一个女人，况且这女人不是别人，是从小崇拜他，跟在他屁股后面的小可怜虫，他怎么能够相信她竟然会拒绝，甚至离开他？！
「我……」她不知道该怎么说，她想求他饶了她，她玩不起他的游戏，不过看他气得狰狞的脸孔，她怀疑他能够听得进去她的话。
她的手机在这个时候响了起来，她从未如此庆幸自己带了手机来上班。
「我先接电话，抱歉。」
挣扎着甩开他的手，拿起手机发现是乔爸来电时，她有种不好的预感。果然——
「欢欢不好了！你快来！小佟摔了一跤，现在在医院里。」
像是有人兜头淋了她一身冰水，她整个人无法克制的颤抖起来。「什、什么医院？我马、马上去……」
她闹着那个像被轰炸过，完全无法思考，只知道要赶到医院，赶到儿子身边。
「你怎么了？发生什么事？」
叶咏欢的脸色像纸一样苍白，身体剧烈的抖动，她失神的样子让苏劲沧大为惊讶。
「我、我要走了……我现在得去宜兰……对不起……我要早退……我要坐计程车……」
她说得语无伦次，模样太过不正常，他不由得担心起来。
「要到宜兰临时可能叫不到车，我送你去。」

她茫然看着他坚定的表情，虽然知道自己应该拒绝，心底有个声音警告她这是不对的，不能让他知道小佟的事，可是她得立刻赶去医院，现在没有什么比那更重要的了！
「……好。」
一路上她都沉默的低着头，十指紧紧交握。
他想要询问她究竟发生什么事，却在看见她一脸泫然欲泣的慌张表情后说不出宜兰有什么人让她这么紧张？
不是她的父母，他知道他们在美国。
唯一知道的只有她好友的父母，上次她去找他们玩，可是朋友的父母住院有必要这么紧张吗？
车子抵达宜兰的医院时，叶咏欢立刻奔进急诊室。
病床上躺着一个小小的人儿，头上绑着绷带，看到她，哭叫着妈妈。
「对不起啊！小欢，这几天小佟鼻塞晚上睡不好，我跟乔爸两个轮流照顾他，可是熬到下午就体力不支，不小心睡着了，被小佟哭声吵醒才发现他竟然从婴儿床爬起来，跌到床下去。」
她紧抱着儿子，听着乔妈说明事情经过，知道不能怪罪乔爸乔妈，他们也都很尽心照顾小佟了，只是看见孩子受伤，心还是好痛呵！
「医生说情况怎么样？」
「目前就是一些皮外伤，照了X光，没有骨折，可就怕有脑震荡，所以要住院观察个一、两天。」
「我知道了，谢谢你们。」
「马麻，呜呜……马麻……」叶咏欢的衣服被儿子给抓皱了，胸前全都是他的眼泪鼻涕，可是她一点都不介意，紧紧抱着儿子，心里充满自责，因为在儿子需要她的时候，她没有第一时间陪在他身边。
苏劲沧错愕的愣在当场，完全无法移动，只能瞠大眼看着她跟她怀里的小孩。
「别哭了，妈妈在这里陪你，不哭了喔！」
轻拍着儿子的背，叶咏欢始终不敢回头，她不用回头就可以感受到背后两道凌厉的视线几乎要把她撕裂。
小佟终于停止哭泣，好奇的张大眼，看着母亲身后高大的男人。
知道躲不过，叶咏欢缓缓的、慢动作般的转头。
果然——

她缩起肩头，害怕的望着苏劲沧那如寒冰一样森冷的视线。
「你给我解释清楚！」他咬牙切齿的嘶吼。
小佟被转进一般病房，经过几个小时的哭闹，现在正平静的睡着。
相较于床上安详的孩子，两个大人之间的气氛就有如腊月的寒风般刺骨。「他叫小佟，叶语佟，出生三千五百克。现在一岁三个月，很聪明，可是有点调皮……」
当她看见他听见小佟的年纪时眼底迸出的寒光，她的声音渐渐弱了。「你该死的为什么没有告诉我？！」
他有个儿子！在他不知道的时候，她一个人怀孕、生产、住在破烂的房子里，身边连一个亲人都没有！
心仿佛被狠狠的踩在地上，想到她在这种情况之下，居然连想也没有想过要通知他一声，他气得想要杀人。
困难的吞下口口水，她低下头，像个做错事的孩子般无措。「我、我们已经没有什么关系了，所以我不想麻烦你……」
他怒极反笑。
不想麻烦他？很好！太好了！难不成他还得感谢她的体贴不成？
「那是我的小孩！你说什么跟我没有关系？！」
叶咏欢被他的怒气吓得发抖，只能结结巴巴的表示，「我以为你不喜欢小孩……也、也不喜欢我……我不敢打扰你，让你以为我又藉故想要跟你在一起……」
他是哪里让她觉得自己不喜欢她了？
起先苏劲沧很不高兴，然后他想到他们短暂的婚姻生活，还有那样不留情面的分开……他沉下脸。
好吧。他不情愿的承认，她的想法不是没有道理。
「算了，过去的事情我不计较。」他很「宽容」的原谅她。「不过你和小孩都得跟我回去。」
「不要。」
她的话让他挑眉。「你说什么？」
「我不要。」叶咏欢的手在抖、身体在抖，可她还是顽固的直视他。
第9章(1)

还是在上次的会议室，一样又是上次那个律师。
叶咏欢缩着身子，咬紧下唇。
「基本上苏先生有权利争取小孩的监护权，只要告上法院，法官看到小孩的出生日期就可以判定这个孩子是在你们离婚前就已经怀上的，苏先生当然是亲生父亲，也就对孩子拥有权利和义务。」
「那我呢？我是他的母亲，我当然也有权利……」
跟上次的默默无语、任人宰割不同，她懂得了出声反抗，律师不由得惊讶也佩服女人果然为母则强。
不过……律师同情起叶咏欢，她要跟苏先生抗争，还是一点胜算都没有呀！
「关于这部分法院会裁量双方的经济条件和家庭状况，来判定小孩究竟跟哪一方在一起比较好。经济条件不用说了，你把孩子托给一堆年长的夫妇照顾，然后造成小孩的意外住院。这个事实在法官眼里看起来可是大大的扣分。」
叶咏欢脸色苍白，害怕让她的大眼里充满惶然与不安。
苏劲沧必须克制住上前将她拥进怀里安慰的冲动。他现在不能这么做。
他是个记仇的人，忘不了她之前说要辞职，而且她的罪状不只这样，还瞒着他孩子的事，如果不是跟她去了宜兰，他可能永远都不知道自己有个儿子。
所以他现在用律师来给她压力，让她认知到她没有后路，只能求他，然后她才会乖乖的待在他身边。
「叶小姐，我建议你最好是跟苏先生达成协议，找出你们两个人都可以接受的方法。」
content_en:
"I, I want to resign, I don't want to see you again!"
She thought about it all night last night. The idea of resigning had been in her mind for a long time, but she just couldn't make up her mind. But recently he has been getting better and better towards her...
Yes, she knew she was conflicted, but the better he treated her, the more scared and uneasy she became.
She was afraid that no matter how much she had expectations, she wouldn't be able to bear being disappointed again.
Now her situation is different from before. She has Xiao Tong and she cannot collapse. She knew very well that if she fell in love with him again and was ruthlessly dumped, she would never be able to get up again.
So she is so scared...
"Resign? No! I won't allow it!" Su Jincang couldn't accept the reaction that was so different from his expectations.
He is not a man who takes no for an answer. This was the first time he wanted to pursue a woman, and besides, this woman was none other than the poor little bastard who had worshiped him since childhood and followed him. How could he believe that she would refuse or even leave him? !
"I..." She didn't know what to say. She wanted to beg him to spare her. She couldn't play his games, but looking at his furious face, she doubted that he could listen to her.
Her cell phone rang at this time, and she had never been so glad that she brought her cell phone to work.
"I'll answer the phone first, sorry."
She struggled to throw away his hand and picked up the phone to find that it was Dad Qiao calling. She had a bad feeling. Sure enough——
"Huanhuan is not good! Come here! Xiao Tong fell down and is in the hospital now."
It was as if someone had poured ice water all over her body, and her whole body was shaking uncontrollably. "W-what hospital? I'll go there right away..."
She felt like she had been bombed and couldn't think at all. She only knew she had to rush to the hospital and to her son.
"What's wrong with you? What happened?"
Ye Yonghuan's face was as pale as paper, and her body was shaking violently. Su Jincang was greatly surprised by her lost look.
"I, I have to go... I have to go to Yilan now... I'm sorry... I have to leave early... I have to take a taxi..."
She spoke incoherently and looked so abnormal that he couldn't help but worry.
"If you want to get to Yilan, you may not be able to get a taxi at the moment, so I'll take you there."
She looked at his firm expression blankly. Although she knew she should refuse, there was a voice in her heart warning her that this was wrong and she couldn't let him know about Xiao Tong. But she had to rush to the hospital immediately. There was nothing more important than that now!
"...Okay."
Along the way, she lowered her head in silence and clasped her fingers tightly.
He wanted to ask her what happened, but after seeing her panicked expression about to cry, he couldn't tell who in Yilan made her so nervous?
Not her parents, who he knew were in America.
The only one she knew was her friend's parents. She went to play with them last time, but was it necessary to be so nervous when her friend's parents were hospitalized?
When the car arrived at the hospital in Yilan, Ye Yonghuan immediately rushed to the emergency room.
There was a little person lying on the hospital bed with a bandage on her head. When she saw her, she cried for her mother.
"I'm sorry! Xiao Huan, little Tong has a stuffy nose these days and can't sleep well at night. Father Qiao and I take turns taking care of him, but we are exhausted after staying up until the afternoon and accidentally fall asleep. I am woken up by little Tong's crying and find that he has climbed up from the crib and fallen under the bed."
She hugged her son tightly and listened to Qiao's mother explaining what happened. She knew that she could not blame Qiao's father and Qiao's mother. They also took good care of little Tong. But seeing the child injured still made her heart hurt!
"What did the doctor say about the situation?"
"Currently it's just some skin trauma. X-rays showed no fractures, but I'm afraid of a concussion, so I need to be hospitalized for one or two days for observation."
"I understand, thank you."
"Mama, wuwu... Ma Ma..." Ye Yonghuan's clothes were wrinkled by her son, and his chest was covered with his tears and nose, butShe didn't mind at all and hugged her son tightly, feeling filled with self-blame because she didn't stay with her son for the first time when he needed her.
Su Jincang was stunned on the spot, unable to move at all, and could only stare at her and the child in her arms.
"Don't cry, mom is here to accompany you, don't cry anymore!"
Patting her son's back, Ye Yonghuan never dared to look back. She could feel the two sharp eyes from behind almost tearing her apart without looking back.
Xiao Tong finally stopped crying and opened his eyes curiously, looking at the tall man behind his mother.
Knowing that she couldn't escape, Ye Yonghuan slowly turned her head in slow motion.
Sure enough——
She huddled her shoulders and looked at Su Jincang's eyes as cold as ice in fear.
"Explain it to me!" he roared through gritted teeth.
Little Tong was transferred to the general ward. After several hours of crying, he is now sleeping peacefully.
Compared to the peaceful child on the bed, the atmosphere between the two adults was as biting as the cold wind in the twelfth lunar month. "His name is Xiao Tong, Ye Yu Tong. He was born at 3,500 grams. He is now one year and three months old. He is very smart, but a little naughty..."
When she saw the cold light in his eyes when he heard Xiao Tong's age, her voice gradually weakened. "Why the hell didn't you tell me?!"
He has a son! When he didn't know it, she was pregnant, giving birth, and living in a shabby house alone, without even a single relative around her!
His heart seemed to be severely stepped on the ground. Thinking that she didn't even think about informing him in this situation, he was so angry that he wanted to kill someone.
Swallowing with difficulty, she lowered her head, as helpless as a child who had done something wrong. "I-we have nothing to do with each other anymore, so I don't want to trouble you..."
He laughed in anger.
Don't want to trouble him? very good! Very good! Could it be that he still had to thank her for her thoughtfulness?
"That's my child! What are you saying has nothing to do with me?!"
Ye Yonghuan was so frightened by his anger that she could only stammer, "I thought you didn't like children...and you didn't like me either...I didn't dare to disturb you and make you think that I wanted to be with you for another reason..."
How did he make her feel that he didn't like her?
Su Jincang was unhappy at first, but then he thought of their short marriage and such a ruthless separation... He darkened his face.
All right. He reluctantly admitted that her idea was not unreasonable.
"Forget it, I don't care about the past." He forgave her very "tolerantly". "But you and the child have to go back with me."
"No."
Her words made him raise an eyebrow. "What did you say?"
"I don't want it." Ye Yonghuan's hands were shaking and her body was shaking, but she still looked at him stubbornly.
Chapter 9(1)
It's still the same lawyer as last time in the conference room.
Ye Yonghuan shrank back and bit her lower lip.
"Basically, Mr. Su has the right to fight for custody of the child. As long as he goes to court, the judge can see the child's date of birth and determine that the child was conceived before your divorce. Of course, Mr. Su is the biological father, so he has rights and obligations to the child."
"What about me? I am his mother, of course I have rights..."
Unlike last time, when she was silent and allowed to be manipulated, she knew how to speak out to resist. The lawyer couldn't help but be surprised and admired that women are indeed strong as mothers.
However...the lawyer sympathized with Ye Yonghuan. If she wanted to fight Mr. Su, she still had no chance of winning!
"Regarding this part, the court will consider the financial conditions and family situation of both parties to determine which party is better for the child to be with. Needless to say, financial conditions, you entrust the child to a bunch of older couples to take care of, and then cause the child to be unexpectedly hospitalized. This fact seems to be a big deduction in the eyes of the judge."
Ye Yonghuan's face turned pale, afraid of letting herHis big eyes were full of panic and uneasiness.
Su Jincang had to resist the urge to step forward and hold her in his arms to comfort her. He can't do that now.
He is a vengeful person and cannot forget that she said she would resign before. Moreover, her crime is not only that, but she also hid her child from him. If he had not gone to Yilan with her, he might never have known that he had a son.
So now he uses lawyers to put pressure on her, making her realize that she has no choice but to beg him, and then she will stay by his side obediently.
"Ms. Ye, I suggest you reach an agreement with Mr. Su and find a method that is acceptable to both of you."
